question: Does the SDPA warm at Qwen36MTPBlockSession.swift:596-680 compile a different vector-mode pipeline from the scored path, because the scored query carries query_transposed=true and the warm query does not?
evidence_kind: actual MLX array shapes and strides at the touched call sites, plus the transcribed MLX predicate
decisive_source_fact: In vector mode (qL <= 8) scaled_dot_product_attention.cpp:686-718 does not read the incoming transpose flag. It applies q_copy_unless first and contiguous-copies any query that fails it, so query_transposed = !row_contiguous && q_copy_unless(q).
q_copy_unless: true if row_contiguous; else if shape[0]==1 or shape[1]==1, with bidx = (shape[0]==1 ? 1 : 0), require strides[3]==1 and strides[2]==shape[3]*shape[bidx] and strides[bidx]==shape[3]
why_row_contiguous: Qwen35Attention.swift:165-193 does rmsNorm, then .transposed(0,2,1,3), then MLXFast.RoPE. RoPE eval_gpu at rope.cpp:66,77 calls out.set_data(allocator::malloc(...)), so the RoPE output is row-contiguous.

controls.name: transposed view
controls.detail: a [B,H,L,D] view built by transposition reports _qt, so the predicate can fail

controls.name: dim-2 slice
controls.detail: a slice on dim 2 reports row_contiguous=false and q_copy_unless=false, so MLX copies it

conclusion: Every width 1 to 9 compiles the same _qnt vector pipeline at both the warm site and the scored site. The warm therefore already compiles the pipeline the scored path uses, and the qL{2,3} later-window warm addition is worth exactly zero. The SDPA warm axis is closed.

named_follow_up.finding: Every chunked SDPA call in the AttentionUtils.swift:127-140 exactness-chunk path performs a hidden contiguous copy of its query slice.
named_follow_up.magnitude: 2 copies x 16 full-attention layers = 32 extra copy dispatches per drafting round, and only at qL >= 6, which is exactly the pb6 pass boundary. Chunk A is 24x5x256 bf16 = 61440 bytes.
named_follow_up.scope_note: AttentionUtils.swift lives in Vendor/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ and is outside the F7 section 5 scope.
